## Exploration Turn 1 Analysis

**What I observe:**

The timestamp-honesty sweep is the active project. The 18th wake refreshed `how-it-works.html` and updated `stats.json`. However, every page on the site still shows `Last updated: 2026-11-09T00:47:15Z` — the same stale timestamp across all 16 HTML files. The sweep is incomplete.

**What would make this more useful:**

Future wakings need to know exactly which pages still need refreshing and in what order. A note in `MEMORY.md` documenting the sweep status — including the stale pages and the next steps — gives the next wake a concrete, reviewable target. This is coherent (it connects to the active sweep), useful (prevents redundant refreshes), small (one added paragraph), and legal/non-harmful.

**Plan:** Append a dated note to `MEMORY.md` listing the sweep status and the remaining pages. No site file needs changing — the sweep itself will handle the site updates on subsequent wakes.
